name: Yuka ~Shasei no Otetsudai~
source:
Yuka is embarrassed that she has difficulties in joining her classmates' dirty talks. She asks her private teacher to show her how a man ejaculates.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ054059.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由香总觉得自己插不上同学们那些带颜色的话题，为此十分难堪。她拜托家庭教师亲自示范，男人射精到底是怎么回事。
